_comment: R0 SEED disclosure-target registry per ADR-2605302130 §2. Each entry is the coded 窓口 / 住所 / メールアドレス / portal / 手続き / fee / deadline so himotoki can route + file procedurally. ALL entries ship verificationStatus=unverified-seed: per G14, NO live dispatch may occur against an unverified entry — these MUST be human/Council-verified (and re-checked within the freshness window) before himotoki_dispatch will transmit. Specific portalUrl / contactEmail / postalAddress / feeJpy / statutoryDeadlineDays below are best-effort public references as of 2026-05-30 and are EXPECTED to drift; treat them as routing scaffolds, not authoritative contacts.

targets.notes: Submit a Data Privacy / Data Subject request via support portal; privacy@discord.com as contact. Verify current form path before dispatch.
Primary self-service access = Google Takeout (data export). Formal right-of-access / deletion routes via the privacy help/troubleshooter flow. Verify current DSAR entry point.
APPI §33 開示等の請求. File via LINE inquiry/contact center; verify the dedicated 個人情報開示請求 form path before dispatch. statutoryDeadlineDays is a target SLA, not a hard statute figure — verify.
Privacy Center 'Download Your Information' for self-service export; DSAR / right-of-access form for formal requests. Verify per-product (FB/IG/WA) routing.
